roadmap_contract.NEW: first evidence creates a short next interval
roadmap_contract.LEARNING: unstable success remains on 1-3 day review
roadmap_contract.LAPSED: wrong answer after mastery reduces interval without deleting history
roadmap_contract.SUSPENDED: unsafe/retired content is not scheduled; concept/history are preserved
roadmap_contract.anti_memorization: scheduler makes SUBTOPIC concept due; serving chooses another eligible question from that subtopic when possible

transitions.event: first scorable evidence, not stable success

transitions.interval_days: preserve; due immediately if old due passed

state_machine.lapse_count_policy: increment only when entering LAPSED from REVIEW; repeated wrongs while already LAPSED do not double-count a single lapse episode
state_machine.history_policy: raw user_answers and spaced_review_events remain auditable; no reset/delete on lapse

stage12_storage_integration.decision: do not overload existing status; add learning_state with exact Stage17 roadmap states

stage15_integration.stable_rule: use Stage15 STRONG band; do not create a second hidden mastery threshold
stage15_integration.version_rule: mastery provider contract mismatch fails closed

stage16_integration.review_retry: resolution evidence only in v0.9; does not advance SRS or mastery
stage16_integration.marked_for_review: may be a due-queue tiebreak only; never pulls a not-yet-due concept forward
stage16_integration.content_issue: hard-exclude the affected question from serving; never count its invalidation as user lapse
stage16_integration.evidence_replay: if content exclusion lowers a REVIEW concept below STRONG, it may return to LEARNING sooner without increasing lapse_count
stage16_integration.suspension: suspend concept only if no safe eligible question remains for that subtopic

question_diversity.soft_rule: exclude last 3 distinct question_uid values for the subtopic when alternatives exist
question_diversity.fallback: if safe pool is non-empty but soft exclusions exhaust it, relax only the diversity exclusion and log DIVERSITY_FALLBACK

failure_contract.action: fail closed; do not write due/state
data-integrity failure; Stage17 creates no QUESTION-scoped concept schedule
do not advance; restore a safe pool first
SUSPENDED; preserve state/history and surface content inventory need
relax only recent-question soft exclusion; log fallback
raw evidence remains authoritative; retry idempotently at Stage21

1/3 day learning steps + growing review interval + 180-day cap
append-only events and lapse_count; no answer deletion

risk_controls.detection: confirmed-content-issue served count must be zero

risk_controls.preventive: Stage15 STRONG defines stability; Stage17 interval is scheduling state, not a second mastery score
risk_controls.detection: scheduler has no independent mastery threshold
